page: Microsoft Azure E96s_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Esv7 server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, featuring 96 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and is equipped with a 480 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. The system is configured with 768.0 GB of RAM, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable to support external storage attachments.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong multi-core processing capabilities and top-tier memory performance. The server achieved a multi-core stress-ng CPU score of 102250.79 and a PassMark CPU score of 109110.34. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with cached small-block read-only operations reaching 7543.56 GB/sec, while uncached large-block reads and writes perform at 349.82 GB/sec and 134.51 GB/sec respectively. The processor's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), contribute to top-tier performance in specialized tasks, as evidenced by a PassMark extended instructions score of 127838.02 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 604.05 GB/sec.

The E96s_v7 demonstrates exceptional performance in database and memory-bound operations, registering 33095.51 operations per second in PassMark database benchmarks and 160.72 million operations per second in Redis SET tests. It also shows strong capabilities in CPU-based machine learning workloads, processing 7B model LLM prompts at 311.71 tokens per second and 70B model prompts at 40.01 tokens per second. Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated compute resources, this server provides high qualitative cost efficiency for enterprise database hosting, large-scale in-memory caching, static web serving, and data-intensive analytical pipelines that do not require local NVMe drives or GPU acceleration.

Although it lacks local storage and GPUs, it is Premium Storage capable.
